title: Vault flow reuses uncleared queue/cost state and lists duplicate excavation grids

impact.description: Retained source report; practical reachability, actual outcome and port applicability require independent review.

notes: Lead supplied by borg-rs, not independently reproduced by Mandos. A function-context link is not proof of the reported defect. Related sub-symptoms remain grouped pending triage.

reported_sources.text:
`borg_flow_vault()`: the flow is not cleared before the grids are
  enqueued, so the queue and costs left by the previous flow are spread
  further; each excavatable grid is listed once per adjacent permanent
  wall (duplicate entries; up to 8 per grid, so `borg_temp_*` could in
  theory overflow).

next_at_import: Check current C and both ports, duplicate-search the exact symptom, then reproduce a legal scenario with controls before a local proposal. No C submission.
